editionLabel: English Alley Cat Games press-pack rulebook, 16-page PDF
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently visited a hospital starts. The rules also allow choosing randomly.
clarifications: This is the multiplayer starting rule. Give that player the First Player token; starting patients are drawn from that player clockwise.

During Patient Intake, the starter rolls the patient dice and chooses an ambulance first, followed clockwise. The starter cannot choose ambulance 1. The player on their right assigns equal-valued dice of different colours to ambulances.
Hospital Improvement follows ambulance-number order. Hospital Activation may be simultaneous; the rules recommend taking turns in ambulance order for your first game.
The player who takes the lowest-numbered ambulance receives the First Player token and starts the next round. Solo play has separate rules.

firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently ate chocolate is the starting player.
houseFallback: If there is a tie or this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: After the Prepare phase, the Start Player marker holder chooses first in Expand & Recruit, followed clockwise. The last player chooses both a Factory Part packet and an Employee packet; the draft then returns anticlockwise so everyone receives one of each.

editionLabel: English second-edition rulebook, ©2019 Red Raven Games
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently won a game takes the first turn. The rules also allow choosing randomly.
clarifications: Give that player the first-player token. After the Prepare phase, players take one action per turn clockwise until everyone has passed.
Everyone starts with six coins. In turn order, the second player receives one extra coin; the third and fourth receive two extra coins each.
This answer covers the second edition. Its optional variants that evoke the first edition do not establish the original edition's starting rule.
